text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper presents a novel energy systems model (MUSE-Ag&LU) that incorporates land use and reforestation dynamics as part of decarbonization pathways, using Brazil as a national-scale case study. While it models future land use changes—including agricultural intensification, deforestation reduction, and reforestation potential—and compares multiple mitigation scenarios (BAU, 2DS-REF, 2DS+REF), land use change is not the primary research focus. Instead, LULC dynamics serve as an input/component to assess interactions with the energy system and carbon mitigation. The model estimates land area liberated (24.4 Mha by 2050) and sequestration potential but does not produce spatially explicit mapped LULC projections or report quantitative accuracy metrics for land use predictions. Thus, it uses LULC change as a supporting element rather than focusing on predicting LULC itself.)
